content: GitHub warns on files >50MiB per push and hard-blocks pushes with files >100MB via standard git; browser upload is capped at 25MB. Recommended repo size <1GB, strongly <5GB. For growing Parquet datasets, Git LFS is the standard solution but note GitHub Pages does NOT serve Git LFS-tracked files correctly (Pages serves the LFS pointer text file, not the binary) — LFS is not a viable option for files that must be publicly fetchable via GitHub Pages.
